αἰτωλῶν: Αἰτωλοί — the Aetolians; masc. gen. pl.
αὐτίκ: αὐτίκα (elided αὐτίκ’) — at once, immediately; adv.

αὐτὸς: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. sg., intensive with the subject: ’myself, yourself, himself’

αὐτῷ: αὐτός — self; masc. dat. sg., as a plain pronoun after a preposition: ’him’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ) · also intensive: ’himself’ · also dat. sg. as a plain pronoun with no preposition, indirect object: ’to him’ (ἥρμοσε … αὐτῷ ’fitted him’) · also dat. sg. as a plain pronoun, of a thing, with a verb of leaning: ’on it’ (αὐτῷ σκηπτόμενον ’leaning on it’) · also dat. sg. as a plain pronoun with ἔοικα: ’to him, like him’ (αὐτῷ … ἐῴκει ’resembled him’) · also dat. sg. as a plain pronoun, of a thing, of accompaniment with ἕπομαι, no preposition: ’with it’ (φρένες αὐτῷ ἕποντο ’the midriffs followed with it’) · also dat. sg. as a plain pronoun, of a person, of accompaniment with ἕπομαι, no preposition: ’him’ (ἕπετ’ αὐτῷ ’followed him’)
αὔτως: αὔτως — just so, idly, without more; adv.: ’merely, to no purpose’ · also in ὣς δ’ αὔτως, ’in the same way’: ’likewise’ · also ’just as one is’ (ἀλλ’ αὔτως … φάνηθι ’but as you are, appear’)
αὖθι: αὖθι — there, on the spot, right there; adv. (cf. αὖθις)
αὖτ: αὖτε (elided αὖτ’) — again, in turn, moreover; epic adv./conj.
βήτην: βαίνω — step, go; aor. 3 dual, unaugmented (= Attic ἐβήτην): ’the two went, stepped’
βίη: βίη — might, bodily strength, force; fem. nom. sg. · also periphrasis for a person, nom. subject: ’the might of Helenus’ (= Helenus himself)
βαλόντες: βάλλω — throw, cast; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having cast’; with περί in tmesis, ’having cast around’ · also ’having put’ (ἐν … βαλόντες ’having put aboard’)
βαρεῖαι: βαρύς — heavy, grievous; fem. nom. pl.
βασιλῆος: βασιλεύς — king; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic βασιλέως)
βορέω: Βορέης — Boreas, the North Wind; masc. gen. sg., epic -έω (= Attic Βορέου)
βουλοίμην: βούλομαι — wish, prefer; pres. opt. 1 sg., potential: ’I would wish’
βούλετο: βούλομαι — wish, want, prefer; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, + acc.: ’he wished for’
βοὸς: βοῦς — ox, cow; gen. sg.: ’of an ox’
γένετ: γίγνομαι — become, happen, come to be; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (γένετ’ = γένετο = ἐγένετο)
γέρον: γέρων — old man; masc. voc. sg.: ’old man!’
γήραϊ: γῆρας — old age; neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic γήρᾳ), dative of cause: ’by old age’ · also dat. after ἐπιτρέπω: ’(yield) to old age’
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle

γνώωσι: γιγνώσκω — know, come to know; aor. subj. 3 pl., epic lengthened (= Attic γνῶσι)
γυῖα: γυῖον — limb; neut. acc. pl., object of ἔλλαβε · also neut. acc. pl., object of λῦσε: ’loosed the limbs’ (λῦσε δὲ γυῖα) · also neut. acc. pl., goal of motion with δέδυκεν: ’has sunk into the limbs’ · also neut. nom. pl., subject of a passive: ’the limbs were loosened’ (λύντο δὲ γυῖα) · also neut. nom. pl., subject of an intransitive active verb: ’the limbs trembled’ (ἔτρεμε γυῖα) · also neut. nom. pl., subject of εἰμί with a predicate: ’the limbs were firm’ (ἔμπεδα γυῖα … ἦν) · also neut. acc. pl., of the part affected, after ὑπήλυθε: ’the limbs’ (τρόμος ὑπήλυθε γυῖα ’trembling crept over the limbs’)
γῆρας: γῆρας — old age; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., after ἐς: ’(into) old age’ · also neut. acc. sg., object of ἐλεήσῃ: ’(have pity on) old age’
δ: δέ (elided δ’) — and, but · also the elided suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Ἄργος δ’ ’to Argos’)
δέ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Οὔλυμπον δέ ’to Olympus’)
δέπας: δέπας — cup, drinking-cup; neut. acc. sg. (nom. identical)
δαίμοσιν: δαίμων — god, divine power; masc. dat. pl.: ’to the gods’
δαμάσασθαι: δαμάζω — subdue, overpower; aor. inf. mid., after ἔδωκαν: ’to overcome’
δαμέντα: δάμνημι (δαμάζω) — subdue, overpower; aor. part. pass. masc. acc. sg., epic -ε- aorist (= Attic δαμασθέντα): ’overcome’
δεινὸς: δεινός — terrible, fearsome; masc. nom. sg.
δεύτερον: δεύτερος — second; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’a second time’ · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial, of order in a sequence of attacks: ’second, next’ (δεύτερον ὁρμηθείς ’rushing second’)
δι: διά — through; prep. + gen. or acc., elided (δι’ = διά): ’through’ (δι’ αἰθέρος ’through the sky’)
δουρὶ: δόρυ — spear; neut. dat. sg., epic δουρί (= Attic δορί)
δοῖεν: δίδωμι — give; aor. opt. 3 pl., wish: ’may they give’ · also aor. opt. 3 pl. in a protasis after εἰ: ’if they should give’
δύω: δύο — two; numeral, epic by-form δύω, indeclinable · also δύω — go into, put on (armour); aor. subj. 1 sg. act., short-vowel subj. after ὄφρ’ ἂν: ’I put on’ (τεύχεα δύω) · also aor. subj. 1 sg. act., in a condition after εἰ … κε: ’go into’ (πύλας καὶ τείχεα δύω ’pass inside the gates and walls’) · also with ἀπό in tmesis, after ἐπεί κ’: ’strip off’ (ἀπὸ τεύχεα δύω ’strip off my armour’)
δώσω: δίδωμι — give; fut. 1 sg.: ’I will give’

δὲ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (οἶκον δὲ ’homeward’)
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δὴν: δήν — for a long time, long; adv.
δῖος: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. nom. sg., epithet of heroes (= fem. δῖα)
δῶκεν: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔδωκεν)

εἰδὼς: οἶδα — know; perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’knowing, who knew’
εἰμι: εἰμί — be; pres. 1 sg., enclitic (accent goes to the word before): ’I am’
εἰπὼν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.

εἴη: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 3 sg.: ’it might be, he might be’; potential with κεν: ’it would be’ · also in a wish after εἴθε: ’would that it were’ · also in a wish or a request: ’let there be’ (εἴη ὃς … ’let there be one who …’) · also in a relative clause: ’were, should be’ (ὅς τις … εἴη ’whoever should be’) · also in a condition after εἰ καί: ’(even) if it were’ · also pres. opt. 3 sg. in a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’may there be’

εὐρύαλος: Εὐρύαλος — Euryalus, an Argive leader; masc. nom. sg.
εὔχομαι: εὔχομαι — declare oneself, avow, boast, pray; pres. 1 sg., + inf.: ’I declare myself (to be)’
ηὔδα: αὐδάω — speak, say; impf. 3 sg., augmented (αὐ- → ηὐ-)
θήβας: Θῆβαι — Thebes; fem. acc. pl. (plural place-name), after ἐς: ’to Thebes’
θαρσύνων: θαρσύνω — encourage, hearten; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’heartening’
θεοὶ: θεός — god; nom. pl. · also voc. pl. (same form): ’you gods!’
θυμοῦ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; masc. gen. sg.
θυμὸς: θυμός — heart, spirit, desire; nom. sg.
θῆκεν: τίθημι — put, place, make; aor. 3 sg., with ν-movable (= θῆκε), with double acc.: ’made (him) conspicuous’ · also ’laid, set’, with acc. and ἐπί + dat.: ’laid it on the knees’

κάλυψεν: καλύπτω — cover, hide; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, ν-movable (= ἐκάλυψεν)
κάρη: κάρη — head; neut. acc. sg., acc. of respect: ’as to the head’ (κάρη κομόωντας ’long-haired’) · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’head’ (κάρη ὤμοισιν ἐπείη ’may the head be on the shoulders’) · also neut. acc. sg., direct object: ’head’ (ἐστήριξε κάρη ’planted her head’) · also neut. acc. sg., subject of an infinitive: ’head’ (κάρη ἕλκεσθαι ἔασεν ’let the head be dragged’)

κέλευεν: κελεύω — bid, command; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἐκέλευε), with movable ν: ’bade’
κέν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · also with an aor. indic., past potential: ’would have’ (κέν … κατέπαυσε ’would have stopped’) · also with αἴ + subj. in a condition: ’if perhaps … can’ · also with the opt., potential: ’could, would’ (πῶς κέν τις ἀκούσαι ’how could anyone hear’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause after ὅτε: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κέν τις … βάλῃ ’whenever someone hits’) · also ἤ κέν + subj. καδμείωνας: Καδμείων — a Cadmean, a Theban; masc. acc. pl. Καδμείωνας, -ων- stem by-form of Καδμείους, after μετά

καμμονίην: καμμονίη — staying power, endurance that wins the day (sense traditional); fem. acc. sg.

κλισίην: κλισίη — hut, shelter, tent; fem. acc. sg. (Attic κλισία)
κλυτὸς: κλυτός — famous, renowned; adj., masc. nom. sg. · also the masc. form used with a fem. name, nom. sg., agreeing with Ἱπποδάμεια
κραδίη: κραδίη — heart; fem. nom. sg. (= Attic καρδία)

ἐγένοντο: γίγνομαι — become, be born; aor. 3 pl. mid.: ’were born’ · also ’came to be, got (on one’s way)’ (πρὸ ὁδοῦ ἐγένοντο ’got well on the road’) · also aor. 3 pl. with a predicate: ’became, fell’ (ἀκὴν ἐγένοντο ’fell silent’)
ἐγὼν: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., form used before a vowel
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’) · also in παρ’ ἐκ (= παρέκ) + acc.: ’beyond’ (παρ’ ἐκ νόον ’beyond reason’)
ἐμήν: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. acc. sg.
ἐμεῖο: ἐγώ — I; epic gen. sg. ἐμεῖο (= Attic ἐμοῦ)
ἐμὸς: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. nom. sg., agreeing with δαήρ · also masc. nom. sg., agreeing with πάϊς: ’my own’
ἐμῇς: ἐμός — my, mine; possessive adj., fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇς (= Attic ἐμαῖς), agreeing with χερσί
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνίκα: νικάω — conquer, surpass, prevail; impf. 3 sg.: ’won, prevailed’
ἐνηέος: ἐνηής — kindly, gentle; masc. gen. sg., epic uncontracted -έος (Attic contraction would be -οῦς), agreeing with ἑτάροιο
ἐνθάδ: ἐνθάδε (elided ἐνθάδ’) — in this place, to this place; adv.
ἐξερέω: ἐξερέω — tell out, declare; fut. 1 sg., uncontracted (= Attic ἐξερῶ): ’I will tell’
ἐοῦσαν: εἰμί — be; pres. part. fem. acc. sg., epic (= Attic οὖσαν)
ἐπείγει: ἐπείγω — press, drive, urge on; pres. 3 sg.
ἐπειοὶ: Ἐπειοί — the Epeans, the people of Elis; masc. nom. pl.
ἐπειῶν: Ἐπειοί — the Epeians, a people of Elis; masc. gen. pl.
ἐπιτλήτω: ἐπιτλάω — endure, bear patiently; aor. imper. 3 sg., athematic aor. (ἐπέτλην): ’let it endure’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain) · also + dat. of place: ’at’ (ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’at the ditch’) · also ἐπὶ ἶσα, adverbial: ’equally, evenly’ · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (right) side’ (ἐπὶ δεξιόφιν ’on the right’) · also + dat. of respect: ’in’ (ἐπὶ φρεσὶ … κέκασται ’excels in wits’) · also + gen., of range: ’as far as’ (ὅσον ἐπὶ δουρὸς ἐρωή ’as far as a spear’s rush carries’)
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’) · also + acc. of time: ’until’ (ἐς ἠέλιον καταδύντα ’until sunset’) · also + acc. of purpose: ’for’ (ἐς βρωτύν ’for food’)
ἐσθλὸν: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; neut. acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masc. noun: ’good, brave’ · also neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’(it is) good’ (ἐσθλὸν … τέτυκται)
ἐϋκνήμιδες: ἐϋκνήμις — well-greaved, epithet of the Achaeans; masc. nom./voc. pl.
ἐόντα: εἰμί — be; pres. part., epic (= Attic ὄντα); masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. pl.: τά τ’ ἐόντα ’the things that are’
ἑ: ἕ — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. sg. reflexive/personal pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/-ήν/-ό)
ἑξέτε: ἑξέτης — six years old; adj. of two endings, fem. acc. sg., epic uncontracted ἑξέτεα, elided ἑξέτε’ (= Attic ἑξέτη)
ἑτέρωσε: ἑτέρωσε — to the other side, to one side; adv.
ἑταίρῳ: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. dat. sg.
ἑταῖροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’companions!’ (ἐρίηρες ἑταῖροι ’trusty companions’)
ἑταῖρον: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. acc. sg.
ἔγωγε: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. with the strengthening particle -γε: ’I for my part’
ἔειπε: εἶπον — say, speak, tell; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept before the root’s own ει- (= Attic εἶπε)
ἔειπεν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 3 sg., epic augmented (ἔ-ειπεν, = Attic εἶπεν)
ἔειπες: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 2 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept (ἔειπες = εἶπες)
ἔθεσαν: τίθημι — put, place, make; aor. 3 pl. act.: ’they made’
ἔλασεν: ἐλαύνω — drive, strike; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἤλασεν): ’drove away’
ἔμιχθεν: μείγνυμι (Attic μίγνυμι) — mix; aor. pass. 3 pl., epic -θεν (= Attic ἐμίχθησαν), intrans.: ’they mingled’
ἔμμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
ἔμπεδα: ἔμπεδος — steadfast, secure, firm; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἔμπεδον: ἔμπεδος — steady, firm, unbroken; adj., neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’steadily’ · also neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’steady’
ἔμπεδος: ἔμπεδος — steady, firm, unfailing; adj. of two endings, masc./fem. nom. sg., predicate
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative adv., ’where’ (ἔνθ’ ἄρα τε φρένες ἔρχαται ’where the midriff is shut’)
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’) · also ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα ’hither and thither, this way and that’
ἔοικε: ἔοικα — be fitting, seem; perf. with pres. sense, impersonal 3 sg.: ’it is fitting’ · also personal, ’is like, resembles’ (+ dat.: βασιλῆϊ … ἔοικε ’is like a king’)
ἔον: εἰμί — be; impf. 1 sg., epic ἔον (= Attic ἦν): ’I was’
ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔπεσιν: ἔπος — word; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσιν (= Attic -εσι), ν-movable: ’with words’
ἔπεσον: πίπτω — fall; aor. 3 pl. (also 1 sg.), augmented (unaugmented πέσον); with σύν in tmesis, σὺν … ἔπεσον = συνέπεσον ’fell together, clashed’ · also with ἐν in tmesis, ἐν … ἔπεσον = ἐνέπεσον ’fell in’ (ἐν δ’ ἔπεσον ’and they fell in’)
ἔργων: ἔργον — deed, work, task; neut. gen. pl.
ἔρρεε: ῥέω — flow; impf. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔρρει): ’flowed’
ἔσαν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἦσαν)
ἔστω: εἰμί — be; pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let there be, let him be’
ἔτ: ἔτι — still, any longer, further; adv., elided (ἔτ’); οὐδ’ ἔτ’ ’nor any more’
ἔφαθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid. (ἔφατο, elided ἔφαθ’, τ>θ before rough breathing)
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἕλε: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἷλε) · also aor. 3 sg. in battle: ’killed’ (Σχεδίον … ἕλε ’killed Schedius’) · also in tmesis (διὰ … ἕλε = διεῖλε): ’tore through’ (διὰ δ’ ἀμφοτέρους ἕλε κύκλους ’tore through both rings’)
ἠΰς: ἠΰς — good, noble, brave; adj., masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἀγαθός)
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἠπεροπεύειν: ἠπεροπεύω — deceive, cheat; pres. inf. act.: ’to deceive’
ἡβώοιμι: ἡβάω — be in the prime of youth; pres. opt. 1 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἡβῴην), in a wish
ἡμίονον: ἡμίονος — mule; acc. sg., also as an adj. of two endings, neut. acc. sg., agreeing with βρέφος: ’of a mule’
ἡνιόχευεν: ἡνιοχεύω — hold the reins, drive; impf. 3 sg.: ’was driving’
ἡρώεσσιν: ἥρως — hero; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic ἥρωσιν)
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’) · also in τί ἢ δέ, a form of τίη δέ: ’why then’ · also ’than, except’ after ἄλλος (ἄλλῳ γ’ ἢ Ἀχιλῆϊ ’than Achilles’) · also in τί ἢ ἐμέ, a form of τίη: ’why’ (τί ἢ ἐμὲ ταῦτα διεξερέεσθε ’why do you ask me these things’) · also ἢ = ἦ, ’truly, surely’ (ἐπεὶ ἢ πολὺ φέρτεροί ’for they are truly far better’) · also ’than’ after φθάνω ’be first’ (φθήσονται … ἢ ὑμῖν ’will tire sooner than you’)
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἤματα: ἦμαρ — day; neut. acc. pl., acc. of time: ’all the days, every day’
ἤνοπος: Ἤνοψ — Enops, father of Thestor; masc. gen. sg.
ἥ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. nom. sg., accented ἥ before γε: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἥ τε κόμη ’and the hair’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, fem. nom. sg., ’which’ (ἥ τε … πέληται ’which shall be’) · also fem. nom. sg. pronoun, accented ἥ before the enclitic οἱ: ’she’ · also relative, fem. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic οἱ: ’who’ (ἥ οἱ … ἰοῦσα ’who, going before him’) · also relative, fem. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic μιν: ’who, which’ (ἥ μιν ἔτικτε ’who bore him’)
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’) · also ἦ … ἦ ’either … or’
ἦτορ: ἦτορ — heart; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. of respect: ’in heart’ (βεβλαμμένον ἦτορ ’stricken in heart’)
ἧς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; fem. gen. sg.: ’whose’ (ἧς εἵνεκα ’for whose sake’) · also ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. gen. sg., agreeing with its noun (ἧς ἀλόχοιο ’his own wife’) · also relative, fem. gen. sg., attracted into the case of its antecedent: ’which’ (τῆς … γενεῆς ἧς ’the breed which’) · also relative, fem. gen. sg., object of ἐέλδομαι: ’for whom (I long)’
ἰάνθη: ἰαίνω — warm, cheer, gladden; aor. pass. 3 sg.: ’was warmed, was gladdened’
ἰσόθεος: ἰσόθεος — equal to a god, godlike (ἴσος + θεός); adj., masc. nom. sg.
ἴτω: εἶμι — go; pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let him go, let him come’
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; conj. + subj. · also relative adv., ’where’ (ἵνα τ’ ἄνδρες … τελέθουσι ’where men become’) · also + opt., in a purpose clause after a past verb: ’so that … might’ (ἵνα μή … ἵκοιτο ’so that … might not come’)
ἵπποισι: ἵππος — horse; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ἵππον: ἵππος — horse; masc. acc. sg., collective: ’horse’ · also acc. sg., of a single horse in apposition to a name: ’the horse’ (Πήδασον … ἵππον ’Pedasus the horse’) · also acc. sg., fem.: ’a mare’
ὀρθὸς: ὀρθός — upright, straight; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’upright’
ὀστέ: ὀστέον — bone; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted, elided (ὀστέ’ = ὀστέα; Attic ὀστᾶ)
ὁμοῖος: ὅμοιος — like, similar; adj., masc. nom. sg., + dat.
ὁπότε: ὁπότε — whenever, when; temporal conj., + opt. in a general clause · also + aor. subj. in a general temporal clause, with no κε: ’whenever’ (ὁπότε … στυφελίξῃ ’whenever it drives’) · also + pres. indic. in a simile: ’as when’ (ὡς δ’ ὁπότε … κάτεισι ’as when … goes down’)
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὄρνυτο: ὄρνυμι — rouse; mid. rise, rush; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= Attic ὤρνυτο): ’rose, rushed’
ὅθ: ὅθι (elided ὅθ’) — where; relative adv. of place · also ὅτε (elided and aspirated ὅθ’) — when; temporal conj.
ὅμιλον: ὅμιλος — crowd, throng; masc. acc. sg.
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’) · also ὅς (τε) as an indirect interrogative without τις: ’who’ (ὅς τε πεφεύγοι ’who had fled’)
ὅτε: ὅτε — when, whenever; temporal conj. · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’)
ὅττι: ὅστις — whoever, whatever; epic ὅττι (= Attic ὅ τι), neut. acc. sg., indefinite: ’whatever’ · also with a superlative: ὅττι τάχιστα ’as quickly as possible’ · also conj. = ὅτι: ’that’ (after a verb of knowing, or ἅλις: ἅλις ὅττι ’enough that’)
ὑπερφίαλος: ὑπερφίαλος — overweening, arrogant, overbearing; adj., masc. nom. sg., agreeing with θυμός
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’) · also prep. + acc. after ἀλύξας, of escape: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ κῆρας ἀλύξας ’escaping the death-fates’) · also prep. + dat. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Τρώεσσι δαμῆναι ’to be overcome by the Trojans’) · also prep. + φι-form of cause: ’under, by’ (ὑπὸ Πηλεΐδαο βίηφιν ’by the might of Peleus’ son’) · also prep. + acc., of time or condition throughout: ’under’ (ὑπὸ μηνιθμόν ’all the while under the wrath’) · also prep. + gen. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Πατρόκλοιο δαμῆναι ’to be subdued by Patroclus’) · also prep. + acc., place where: ’beneath’ (ὑπὸ γαῖαν ’beneath the earth’) · also prep. + φι-form of place: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ ζυγόφι ’from under the yoke’)
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’) · also ὡς ὅτε, ’as when’, introducing a simile · also introducing a wish with the optative alone: ’would that’ (ὡς ἔρις … ἀπόλοιτο ’would that strife perish’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὥ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom./acc. dual (= Attic ὥ): ’the two whom’
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’) · also ὥς τε + inf.: ’so as to’ (ὥς τε νέεσθαι ’so as to go home’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μοι, ’as’ (ὥς μοι δοκεῖ ’as it seems to me’) · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing an indirect statement after a verb of remembering: ’how’ (ὥς μ’ … ἔρεξεν ’how he treated me’) · also ὥς = ὡς, ’like, as’, accented after its noun (βόες ὥς ’like cattle’) · also ὥς before the enclitic τοι, in a clause after πείθεο: ’as’ (ὥς τοι … θείω ’as I set for you’) · also ὥς accented before the enclitic τις (ὥς τίς τε λέων ’like some lion’)
ὧδε: ὧδε — in this place, in this way, thus; adv.
ᾤχετ: οἴχομαι — go, be gone; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ᾤχετ’ = ᾤχετο): ’went’
ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative, masc./neut. dat. sg.: ’to whom’ · also possessive, ’his own’ · also relative, masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’with which’ · also relative, masc. dat. sg., of the person affected: ’about whom’ (ᾧ … περὶ ῥόπαλ’ ἐάγῃ ’about whom clubs are broken’) · also relative, neut. dat. sg., object of ἐπέπιθμεν: ’in which’ (ᾧ ἐπέπιθμεν ’in which we trusted’) · also relative, masc./neut. dat. sg., with πέρι: ’around which’
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
